description: Ports T-SQL stored procedures and functions to PostgreSQL for the dualdb tool, and decides which ones cannot be ported confidently. Use whenever you see CREATE PROCEDURE, CREATE FUNCTION, EXEC, CommandType.StoredProcedure, an output parameter, a RETURN code, RAISERROR, a cursor, or a .sql file containing procedural logic. Covers the mandatory PL/pgSQL par_/var_ naming rules.
